description:
src/methods/mod.rs:74 declares `updated: Option<HashMap<String, T>>`. RFC 8620 §5.3 says the `updated` map is keyed by id with values that are either an Updated object OR null (server returns null when the update was applied with no extra info to report).

Trigger: server returns `{"updated": {"ev1": null, "ev2": null}, ...}` after a successful CalendarEvent/set update. Current code calls `extract_response::<SetResponse<CalendarEvent>>` (event.rs:88). serde will fail to deserialize `null` into `CalendarEvent` (Calendar, ParticipantIdentity, etc).

Bad behavior: every typed `*_set` call that performs an update of an existing object — the most common JMAP write — will return `ClientError::Parse` instead of a successful SetResponse, even though the server's response is fully spec-compliant.

Wire shape required by RFC 8620 §5.3: `updated: Option<HashMap<Id, Option<T>>>`. Note the inner Option AND that the key is an Id, not an arbitrary String.

Cross-crate note: jmap-mail-client/src/methods/mod.rs:77 has the same field shape and the same bug. File scope here is calendars-client; mail-client should get its own follow-up.

Smoke test in tests/calendar_smoke_tests.rs:91 only exercises 'created', not 'updated', so it does not surface this. Add a test covering the update-success path to lock down the fix.
title: SetResponse<T>.updated cannot deserialize per-id null values
